failure_modes.recovery: Call myinvois_customer_list to find a valid id.
failure_modes.when: the id does not name a customer in your tenant

description: Read one registered buyer by id: name, TIN, BRN, SST number, address and contact. myinvois_invoice_generate seals the name, TIN, BRN, address and contact; the buyer's SST number stays on this record and is not sealed on the e-invoice. Refuses an id outside your tenant with NOT_FOUND: call myinvois_customer_list or myinvois_customer_search for valid ids. NEXT: myinvois_invoice_generate with this id as customer_id.
name: myinvois_customer_read
